executive_summary: Getinge delivered stable Q2 2025 with 4.1% organic sales growth and margin improvement despite significant tariff (-110 MSEK) and currency (-158 MSEK EBITA) headwinds. Paragonix exceeded expectations with positive EBITA contribution ahead of schedule. First clinical use of next-gen EVH product Vasoview Hemopro 3 in US.
key_highlights: Organic sales growth of 4.1% with all business areas and regions contributing
Paragonix making positive EBITA contribution earlier than expected
First Vasoview Hemopro 3 clinical cases successfully conducted in US
Partnership with Zimmer Biomet for ASC segment in US
Free cash flow SEK 510 M, up from 289 M in Q2 2024
New Ultima 1600 washer launched for Life Science

ceo_letter.author: Mattias Perjos
ceo_letter.title: President & CEO

promises.statement: We see no need to change our long-term financial target considering tariff levels noted in Q2
Net sales for 2025 are expected to increase by 2-5% organically

challenges.challenge: Close to -270 MSEK in tariffs and negative currency effects vs prior year
Short term forced to absorb most of tariff costs

honesty_signals: Openly acknowledges being forced to absorb most tariff costs short-term
Discusses Bio-Processing challenges and restructuring response
Mentions analyzing supply chain adaptation opportunities

key_quotes.quote: Paragonix is continuing to impress, with another sales record in the quarter. The operations also made a positive contribution to Getinge's EBITA margin, slightly earlier than expected
Short term we have been forced to absorb most of the tariff costs
Given our performance and dialogue with customers, my outlook for the remainder of 2025 is positive, even though geopolitical risk is elevated

key_narratives: Stable organic growth across all business areas and regions despite headwinds
Paragonix integration exceeding expectations with early positive margin contribution
Price adjustment strategy successfully offsetting some tariff impact
Bio-Processing rationalization fully underway for profitable growth when demand returns
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management views Q2 as continued positive momentum despite significant external headwinds. Focus on price adjustments and supply chain adaptation as key responses to tariff environment.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Continued success handling increased ventilator demand. First Vasoview Hemopro 3 clinical cases in US. ECLS consumables order intake remains high.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Sterile Transfer growth strengthening. Bio-Processing rationalizations underway. Launched new Ultima 1600 washer. 99.9% renewable energy at Halland site.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Infection Control and Digital Health Solutions delivering significant growth. XEN brand products launched in US. Zimmer Biomet ASC partnership announced.

operational_highlights: First Vasoview Hemopro 3 clinical cases successfully conducted in US
Servo-c ventilator extended with neonatal option
Paragonix 100th kidney transplant with KidneyVault System
Complete Intra-Aortic Balloon catheter portfolio (Class III) EU MDR certified
XEN brand cleaning/disinfection products launched in US
Zimmer Biomet ASC partnership for US market
concerns_mentioned: Tariff costs of approximately SEK -110 M in quarter
Currency effects SEK -158 M on adjusted EBITA
Net interest-bearing debt increased after Paragonix acquisition

risks.risk: Geopolitical risks including tariffs and trade barriers

targets.notes: Long-term target maintained despite tariff headwinds

guidance.commentary: Positive outlook for remainder of 2025 despite elevated geopolitical risk. No change to long-term financial targets.
